To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the culture of the manufacturing plant is related to AMT outcomes.
organizational culture is significantly related to AMTs implementation outcomes, and that the relationships vary by type of AMT implementation outcome and by type of organizational culture.
organizational culture is related significantly to AMT implementation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between organizational culture and advanced manufacturing implementation.
the impact of organizational culture on AMT implementation.
how organizational culture influences the successful implementation of AMT.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the implementation of AMT is more successful in those organizations with a culture that is characterized as being both flexible and stable.
the results of this study suggest that organizational culture is related in a significant way to the successful implementation of AMT.
the implementation and success of AMT are significantly affected by the organizational culture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
organizational culture is an important variable to consider when implementing advanced manufacturing technology (Barker, 1998).
organizational culture does matter in terms of AMT implementation.

the organizational culture is an important determinant of the success of advanced manufacturing technology implementation and that managers need to be aware of the impact that organizational culture has on the success of AMT implementation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
managers who are implementing AMTs should be cognizant of the cultural context of their organization and how this may impact their ability to achieve desired outcomes from AMT implementation.
managers should be aware of the importance of culture and its relationship to technology implementation.
managers should consider how organizational culture is likely to influence the success of advanced manufacturing technology implementation.
